scripts.build: npm run build -w @tutor-matcher/shared && npm run build -w @tutor-matcher/auth-service -w @tutor-matcher/wallet-service -w @tutor-matcher/notification-service -w @tutor-matcher/booking-service -w @tutor-matcher/messaging-service -w @tutor-matcher/tutor-service -w @tutor-matcher/review-service && npm run build -w @tutor-matcher/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tutor-matcher/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint packages/shared/src services/auth-service/src services/wallet-service/src services/notification-service/src services/booking-service/src services/messaging-service/src "services/tutor-service/src/**/*.ts" "services/review-service/src/**/*.ts" apps/web
scripts.contracts: uv run --offline --with jsonschema==4.26.0 --with pyyaml==6.0.3 python contracts/validate.py --collection "postman/collections/Tutor Matcher Target Public v1" && node contracts/check-proto.cjs
scripts.test:marketplace: npm run build -w @tutor-matcher/shared && npm test -w @tutor-matcher/tutor-service && npm test -w @tutor-matcher/review-service
